description: Label conflicts verified by hand against the upstream records (parent, 2026-11-01; docs/dev-results.md run 3 and run 4). In each, a legitimate-labelled case and a failure case of a family the investigator checks share a record that is defective in the failure case, so the two labels cannot both hold. Only these pairs leave the sensitivity view of the cohort; the generic rule in evaluation/cohort.py only proposes candidates.

verified.defect: PAY_0420351 is a leg of the split payment of invoice INV_0425052 (the legitimate case's primary entity) and the primary payment of the F09 case: its payment journal is balanced but for the wrong amount (scenario balanced_wrong_amount).
PAY_0424667 is a leg of the legitimate split payment and the primary payment of the F09 case; its journal is posted for the wrong amount.
PAY_0420796 is a leg of the legitimate split payment and the primary payment of the F09 case; its journal is posted for the wrong amount.

The legitimate due-date case's invoice INV_0426722 is also allocated to PAY_0424634, the primary payment of the F09 case, whose journal (4961.50) differs from the payment (4784.47). The legitimate case's own payment is PAY_0424633.

INV_0424017 is the invoice the legitimate net-fee payment PAY_0420261 is allocated to and the invoice of the F08 case (missing final approval); its approval event was removed, so the payment was released without a final approval.
